item.title: Dopamine v3.0.11
item.description:
Dopamine 3.0.11 | Dopamine
- Fix support for iOS 26.0 beta 1 [3.0.1 regression] - Fix boot logo not being cleaned up correctly before backboardd starts, fixes framebuffer getting stuck with it's last content during sbreload when a boot logo is used (now the screen will correctly fade to a black screen like when no boot logo is used) - Update opainject and litehook
